HPX_PRINTERS_DETAILS.py.class_summary: This class implements Android UI automation flows for HP printer details screen interactions. It follows a pattern of swipe-to-find-and-click for tile elements, with configurable retry attempts and timeout handling. Notable patterns include: (1) Consistent use of max_swipes parameter for element discovery, (2) Uniform timeout and raise_e parameters across methods, (3) Exception raising when elements cannot be found after max attempts, (4) Verification methods for UI element presence, (5) Navigation and interaction methods for printer configuration and information retrieval.
